rows.heading: Study Leave Eligibility & Approval
rows.quote_snippet: 6.1 Purpose & Eligibility: Study leave may be granted to an executive to undergo specialized postgraduate study, executive fellowship, or research directly relevant to the hydrocarbon exploration, reservoir development, drilling engineering, or corporate finance operations of the Corporation. 6.2 Minimum Service Prerequisite: An executive must have completed a minimum of 5 (five) years of continuous regular service in ONGC to be eligible for consideration for study leave. 6.3 Maximum Duration: The maximum duration of study leave that may be granted during an executive's entire service shall be 24 (twenty-four) months. This may be extended to a maximum of 36 months for an approved doctoral research program (Ph.D.) with the specific sanction of Director (HR). 6.4 Competent Sanctioning Authority: Study leave within India shall be sanctioned by Director (HR); study leave outside India shall require the approval of the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD).

rows.heading: Study Leave Service Bond
rows.quote_snippet: 7.1 Mandatory Service Bond Execution: Every executive granted study leave shall execute a formal legal service bond with two solvent sureties prior to proceeding on leave, binding themselves to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of 3 (three) completed years upon resumption of duty following completion of the study course. 7.2 Financial Penalty on Breach: In the event of resignation, abandonment of service, or dismissal within 3 years of returning from study leave, the executive shall be liable to refund in full to the Corporation: (a) The entire amount of leave salary, allowances, tuition fees, and book grants paid during the period of study leave; (b) Travel costs, airfares, and visa fees incurred by the Corporation; and (c) Compound interest thereon calculated at the prevailing commercial bank lending rate plus 2% per annum from the date of payment.
